description: A pill for filters, technologies and statuses. A tone for what state a thing is in or a ramp slot for which thing it is, and an optional dismiss.

tone.description: What state the tag reports; neutral reports none. Ignored while `colorId` names a ramp slot, because a tag draws one colour and the two mean different things.

colorId.description: An identity colour from the categorical ramp, the ramp the charts and the calendar read, so one entity keeps its colour across a chart, a schedule and a label. Colour here means which thing and never what state, which is why it replaces `tone` rather than joining it: a label reading "Backend" is not a warning, and a tag that could say both at once would say neither. Optional, and its absence is the tone tag. The slot reaches the tag as `data-arena-color-id` and its colour through the hue channels (`--arena-hue-ink`, `--arena-hue-edge`, `--arena-hue-fill-strong`, `--arena-hue-fill-soft`), so an appearance that fills the marker rather than outlining it is a style plugin's to write and needs no member here.

removable.description: Whether the dismiss × is shown. Every layer gates the × on this member and never on whether anything listens for `remove`, because Arena never derives what it draws from what a consumer listens for. Removability is a declared input, not something inferred from the event.

disabled.description: Whether removal is unavailable while the tag stays visible: a filter a consumer's permissions lock, not a tag that is merely inert. The × carries `aria-disabled` rather than the native `disabled` attribute. A screen-reader user finds it where `tabStop` puts it and is told the action is unavailable. With `removable` false there is no × and nothing to disable.

tabStop.description: Whether the remove button is reached from the page's Tab sequence. Set false when the tag lives inside a composite that manages its own focus (a field holding its chosen values as chips, with one tab stop and arrow keys between them), where reaching it by Tab would be a second way in. Arena writes tabindex="-1" and the button stays programmatically focusable; a positive tab order is not expressible and never should be. With `removable` false there is no button and nothing to hold out.

remove.description: The dismiss × was activated. Never emitted while `disabled`.
